intent: Allow independently operating CoFronts and CoPreGeneric consumers to discover, verify, challenge, reuse and project public evidence without inventing cross-session synchronization.

co_seed.rule: No evidence, no promotion; do not silently replace older source.

co_path.failure: HOLD with explicit blocker, preserve last-known-good and rollback reference
co_path.fanout: Consumers opt in to polling or webhooks; no cross-front automatic delivery is claimed.
co_path.recovery: Read manifest, verify source blobs, replay receipts and reconcile supersession.

co_front.consume_rule: Each front records manifest version, evidence used, rejected candidates, own output URI, test results, receipt and next review time.
non_claims: X2 or CoStead is running this contract
all historic sessions have been recovered

dual_projection.translation_proof: For every projected claim retain source ID, scope, confidence, authorization and reverse lookup.

acceptance_tests.pass_when: manifest and each referenced blob fetched and hash-matched
every public claim traceable to authorized source
synth and bio projection preserve claim scope and uncertainty
independent front records successful ingestion receipt
a clean recovery replays same current head after >24 hours
missing or revoked source fails closed and preserves previous head

next: Implement consumer and test runner; produce independently verified receipt before claiming integration.
